ConditionFunction.description: ConditionFunction is one function or macro a library adds, with only the overloads it adds (ext.Network adds overloads to the standard library's own string function, and only those are its).

Description.description: Description is the library's own description of it, which may be empty.

Macro.description: Macro is set for an AST-rewriting construct such as optMap.

Name.description: Name is the function or macro, as a condition calls it.

Overloads.description: Overloads are a function's signatures, each with its examples; a macro has one, with no signature.

ConditionLibrary.description: ConditionLibrary is what one entry of CELLibraryOptions adds to a condition's environment: its functions, then its macros.

Functions.description: Functions are the functions and macros the library adds.

Name.description: Name is the library, as cel-go or this engine names it.

ConditionOverload.description: ConditionOverload is one signature and its examples.

Examples.description: Examples are the library's examples of a call, which may be none.

Signature.description: Signature is the overload's argument and result types; empty for a macro.

DocRoot.description: DocRoot is one name a template or condition reads, and what it holds.

holds.description: Holds says what the name holds, in a sentence.

name.description: Name is the name as a template or condition writes it.

description: ConditionsTopic is `pleiades doc conditions --json`: what a when, when_or or when_cel condition may read and call. Printed by pleiades doc conditions --json. schema_version is the major version: it goes up only for a change an existing reader could misread, a field removed or renamed or given another type or meaning. Within a major version a newer producer may add fields, and new values to the open sets. So a reader ignores a field it does not know, treats a status or kind it does not know as not a pass, and refuses a major version it does not know.

forms.description: Forms are the three ways a task is gated.

libraries.description: Libraries are what the condition language adds beyond CEL's own operators and macros, one entry per library, read from the engine.

roots.description: Roots are the names a condition may read.

schema_version.description: SchemaVersion is this document's major version, ConditionsVersion.

title: Pleiades doc conditions
